name: Text
description: Responsive text primitive with seven token-based sizes, two weights and configurable semantic markup.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward native attributes for the selected text element.
semantics.guidance: Use sm normal for body copy and lg bold for headings. Select semantic markup independently from visual size.

props.name: content
props.description: Fallback string content when children are not supplied.

props.name: as
props.type: span | p | div | label | strong | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6

accessibility: Choose the element from document structure and meaning, not visual size.
Do not use a larger visual size as a substitute for heading semantics.
Preserve the semantic color token in light and dark themes.
adaptationRules: Implement Text as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Map all sizes and weights to existing design tokens.
Keep semantic element selection independent from visual styling.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any dependency solely for this component.
